title: Australian rental applications: timelines and rejections

## I. Background and the Question

Competition for rentals in Australia is intense, especially at the start of the academic term and just before holidays,

and many students applying for the first time anxiously ask:

> “It has already been three days since I submitted my application. Why have I not heard back?”

“If my application is rejected, does that mean I cannot apply for other properties during this period?”

In fact, **waiting for an application result is one of the most common stages of the rental process**.

Different agents and landlords review applications at different speeds, but there are reasons behind the differences.

---

## II. How Long Does It Take to Hear Back After Applying?

According to statistics from cooperation data between the Qrent platform and major Australian agencies (Ray White, LJ Hooker, PRD and Belle Property),

most rental applications receive feedback within **2–5 business days**.

| Situation | Average Response Time | Explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard property | 2–3 business days | The landlord reviews it directly, so progress is faster |
| Highly competitive property (multiple applicants) | 3–5 business days | The agent needs to collate the documents before submitting them to the landlord |
| Student accommodation or a new development | 5–7 business days | Applications are usually reviewed centrally by head office, making the process slower |

💡 **Qrent reminder:**

Australian agents usually work from Monday to Friday,

so if you submit your application over the weekend (Friday night – Sunday),

you are very likely not to receive feedback until Tuesday or Wednesday of the following week.

---

## III. Why Do Review Times Differ?

1️⃣ **Whether the Landlord Is Based in Australia**

> Some landlords are overseas, so the agent has to wait for email confirmation.

2️⃣ **Too Many Applicants**

> If a property has a high number of views on Qrent or Domain, the agent needs to screen the documents before compiling recommendations.

3️⃣ **Incomplete Application Documents**

> Missing reference letters, bank statements or proof of identity will delay the review.

4️⃣ **The Lease Period Does Not Match the available date**

> If you want to move in in December (month 12), but the landlord wants to hand over the property in November (month 11), the system will automatically delay processing.

📎 The Qrent system's “application tracking feature” automatically updates the status notification when the landlord views an application or makes a preliminary decision (for example: Under Review / Shortlisted / Declined).

---

## IV. What Should You Do If Your Application Is Rejected?

Being rejected does not mean you are “unqualified”,

and often it simply means that “someone else is a better fit”.

For example:

> Someone may be able to move in earlier, take a longer lease, or submit more reference documents.

**After a rejection, you can immediately apply for other properties.**

Australia does not have a “rental blacklist” or systematic restrictions,

and every application is reviewed independently.

---

### 🔁 Qrent's Recommended Response Strategies

| Situation | Recommended Action |
| --- | --- |
| Rejected once | Check that the application documents are complete and the Cover Letter is specific |
| Rejected multiple times | Choose an area or property type with less competition (Qrent marks “low-competition properties”) |
| Reason for rejection is unclear | You can politely email the agent to ask: “Hi, could you please let me know if there was any issue with my rental application? I would like to improve it next time.” |
| Multiple people sharing | Designate a main applicant and submit the documents together to avoid inconsistent information |

💡 **Qrent feature tip:**

Use the “AI property scoring + area competition analysis” module

to predict a property's popularity before applying and choose options that are easier to get approved for.

---

## V. How Can You Shorten the Waiting Time?

1️⃣ **Submit a Complete Application Package**: Include your passport, visa, CoE, bank statements, reference letters and Cover Letter.

2️⃣ **Follow Up Without Pressuring the Agent**: You can politely ask once after 2–3 business days; avoid emailing every day.

3️⃣ **Set Up Multiple Backup Properties**: Use Qrent's favourites feature to apply in parallel and improve efficiency.

4️⃣ **Keep Your Phone Reachable**: Some agents will call directly to confirm information.

---

## VI. Qrent Reminder: You Can Still Take Action While Waiting

During the days you are waiting for a result, you can:

- Browse Qrent's “daily high-scoring property recommendations”;

- Compare rents and features in similar areas;

- Prepare your next application package in advance.

Having alternatives ready is more useful than “anxiously fixating on one property”.

---

## VII. Summary and Key Points

- Results are generally available within 2–5 business days; student accommodation or new developments may take longer;

- Applications submitted over weekends or holidays are usually reviewed later;

- You can apply for other properties immediately after a rejection, and it will not affect your credit;

- The key is: complete application documents + applications to multiple properties + polite communication;

- Qrent tools can help track application status and identify properties with a higher chance of approval.

Qrent suggestion:

> “A rental application is like sending out your CV. The best strategy is to prepare thoroughly and send out several applications.”

You can always apply for the next home that suits you better.
